title: Term
description: A clause within an Instrument. Bound to gist:ContractTerm. A Term creates Obligations and may defeat other Terms.

section.description: Section / article / paragraph identifier within the parent Instrument.

parent_instrument.description: IRI of the of:Instrument this Term belongs to.

creates.description: IRIs of of:Obligation records created by this Term.

defeats.description: IRIs of of:Term records this Term overrides per defeasibility semantics. General/fallback predicate; use rebuts or undercuts when the LegalRuleML §7.4 distinction is known.

rebuts.description: IRIs of of:Term records this Term rebuts. Subproperty of of:defeats (v0.2): the defeating Term denies the *conclusion* of the defeated Term — a counter-rule asserting the opposite outcome (LegalRuleML §7.4). Any of:rebuts assertion also entails of:defeats.

undercuts.description: IRIs of of:Term records this Term undercuts. Subproperty of of:defeats (v0.2): the defeating Term denies the *applicability* of the defeated Term in this context — an exception that says the rule doesn't fire here, without contradicting it elsewhere (LegalRuleML §7.4). Any of:undercuts assertion also entails of:defeats.

anchors.description: IRIs of of:Term records this Term interprets or references. Used by JIAs and other interpretive Instruments whose Terms ground out in a statutory Term. Cross-portfolio joins (PubLedge JIA Term → EveryAILaw statutory Term) use this predicate.

executableEncoding.description: Optional pointer to one or more executable encodings of this Term's logic. A single object or a non-empty array — a Term MAY carry multiple encodings, one per engine (PROTOCOL.md 'ExecutableEncoding shape').

sameAs.description: owl:sameAs crosswalk IRIs: external records identical to this one (e.g. a live adopter export, a Wikidata entity).

exactMatch.description: skos:exactMatch crosswalk IRIs: external concepts interchangeably usable with this record. Weaker than owl:sameAs; preferred for cross-scheme concept joins.

notes.description: Free-text editorial or provenance notes about this record.
